subject: Important Update: Your Account Security
body: Dear valued customer, We are writing to inform you about a recent security breach that affected a small number of accounts. Your account was not directly impacted, but as a precautionary measure, we recommend changing your password immediately. Please log in to your account and update your password to ensure the security of your personal information. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to contact our customer support team. Thank you for your attention to this matter. Sincerely, Security Team
